Missing bundle returns incomplete-package error with a maintenance route; no browser launch performs npm/build/install or enables advanced profiles.
Strict explorer configuration is optional-safe-default or explicit validated selected-project configuration; no depot IDs/labels become shared frontend constants.
verification_steps: Verify manifest rejects unknown/encoded traversal/symlink assets and excludes repository trees, node_modules, caches, unnecessary maps and package-manager files from HTTP.
Run controlled offline production smoke with external network disabled after an explicitly authorized build; observe CSP failures rather than weakening policy.

tasks.title: Implement semantic reader shell and Overview
tasks.action: Create Overview/Terms/Processes/Map navigation with persistent project/search, configured real starting identities, responsive semantic landmarks and secondary theme/help.
acceptance_criteria: The first screen exposes only reading destinations and no authoring/advanced modules; no giant graph or management counters are initial navigation.
Overview uses validated project purpose/starting IDs; empty local graph explains imported core vocabulary and offers categories/search.
verification_steps: Inspect production module graph and DOM for AT-01 exclusion compliance.
Exercise a neutral-only fixture and a specialized category mapping without editing shared frontend code.

tasks.title: Implement discoverable accessible search and browsing
tasks.action: Build compact results, alphabetical/category browse, removable filter chips, preserved query empty states and optional accessible autocomplete using deterministic API responses.
acceptance_criteria: Visible labeled search and submit work without shortcuts; autocomplete follows Arrow/Enter/Escape behavior without deleting query.
Results show supported category, preferred label, recorded excerpt and distinctions; lower-frequency filters remain under one control.
All bound/incomplete/empty cases preserve query and offer useful narrow/clear/continue actions without invented totals.
verification_steps: Browser-test AT-02 through AT-06 including multi-page filtering and ambiguity; verify no automatic identity selection.
Keyboard-test suggestions, announcements and focus while typing/cancelling; a late prior query cannot replace current results.

tasks.title: Implement faithful entries and evidence drawer
tasks.action: Build name/definition-first entry reading with optional canonical context, relationships, technical Details, source drawer, View on map and safe copy actions.
acceptance_criteria: Definitions/aliases/scope/examples/non-examples remain exact; historical status, source freshness and authority meanings are distinct with warnings by affected information.
Relationship member, qualifier, direction and exact ID are independently inspectable; lengthy qualifiers remain accessible and cannot look unconditional.
Opening source retains entry, moves focus meaningfully, escapes text and returns focus to exact trigger on close.
verification_steps: Run AT-07, AT-08, AT-09, AT-13, AT-14, AT-19, AT-20, AT-27 with defined/missing sections, deprecated replacements, long qualifiers and stale sources.
Check Copy local link excludes session data and states dependence on the live local service; stable-ID copy is durable.

tasks.title: Implement stable history and harmless preferences
tasks.action: Separate selected identity, focus, search/filters, expanded IDs, snapshot and source panel state; encode safe routes/history and project-namespaced theme/layout preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Back/Forward restores useful reading/map context; deliberate node selection pushes one history item while camera movements do not spam history.
Terms/Map switching preserves exact identity; credentials are absent from safe routes and copied links; normal new-tab entry links work after authentication where practical.
Theme light/dark/system and reset affect presentation only; source bodies and knowledge are not persisted to browser databases/storage.
verification_steps: Test route round-trips, back/forward, malformed ID, old project context, safe post-auth restoration and AT-22 response races.
Inspect browser storage after sources/maps and reset; only documented harmless project-specific preferences and necessary transient session handling remain.

tasks.title: Implement source-supported process reading
tasks.action: Project supported process fields with numbered source-backed order when recorded and preserve the exact missing-order text when sequence is absent or ambiguous.
acceptance_criteria: Purpose/applicability/roles/inputs/outputs/skills/documents/order each link to exact selected canonical or source support; unsupported fields are omitted.
Absent ordering displays exactly: An ordered description has not been recorded. These are the documented relationships.
Paths/dependencies/layout are never inferred as process execution order; process pages execute nothing, and no additional graph library or authoring is introduced.
verification_steps: Run AT-17, AT-18 with supported ordered, unordered, ambiguous branch and stale/missing source examples.
Compare displayed sequence/branches to source sections; inspect process navigation through keyboard and source drawer.

tasks.title: Implement focused graph renderer and controls
tasks.action: Implement the renderer adapter and bounded stable 2D map with distinct select/focus/expand, canonical IDs, directed labeled edges, qualifier inspection, pan/zoom/Fit/Reset and failure fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Initial Map uses a selected ID or reviewed picker and one-step bounded data; selecting updates details without camera/focus change.

Focus here deliberately replaces neighborhood; expansion preserves existing positions where practical, stops bounded layout and respects cumulative 100-node/200-edge proposed ceiling and tighter service limits.
Parallel IDs, self-loops, cycles, conditional qualifiers, direction and selected/adjacent labels remain faithful; no continuous hidden simulation or unsupported semantic position claim.
verification_steps: Run AT-10, AT-11, AT-12, AT-13, AT-14, AT-15 on actual production renderer, high-degree fixture and timeout fallback.
Measure that selection does not recreate graph, leaving Map disposes instances/listeners/timers/observers, and reduced motion stops animation.

tasks.title: Provide complete equivalent relationship List
tasks.action: Build accessible first-class List from the exact normalized data used by Map, retaining selection, filters, returned scope, IDs/direction/evidence and identical focus/more-connection semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Every substantive graph relation and warning is available in List; switching preserves data scope and selected identity.
Entry/evidence/focus/expand actions work with keyboard and list without canvas/drag/hover/double-click; graph does not add hundreds of invisible tab stops.
verification_steps: Run AT-16, AT-29 and compare relation ID sets, endpoint/predicate direction, qualifiers, source IDs, limits and selection on Map/List switching.
Complete a full neighbor-and-return knowledge task using keyboard and List only.

tasks.title: Integrate truthful loading and failure recovery
tasks.action: Integrate region-scoped loading/errors, session/service recovery, coherent Refresh knowledge, response sequence checks, renderer fallback and responsive theme/reflow behavior.
acceptance_criteria: AT-21, AT-22, AT-23, AT-34 preserve useful context, reject stale responses and mixed snapshots, discard incompatible expansions/cursors on refresh and keep List/evidence usable if renderer fails.
No recorded relationships are labeled as No relationships are recorded in this view; byte/time/traversal limits and incomplete data remain separate from absence.
320 CSS-pixel layouts, substantial zoom, both themes and reduced motion preserve controls, reading, narrow drawers and vertically flowing process/source text.
verification_steps: Inject out-of-order fetches, session expiry, server stop, invalid config, renderer exception, layout timeout and mid-navigation publication.
Observe focus restoration/announcements, 320px reflow, zoom and dark/light contrast on production assets.

tasks.title: Verify dedicated service security and isolation
tasks.action: Run adversarial request/asset/source/session tests and runtime import/call audits against the built reader and simultaneous selected projects.
acceptance_criteria: AT-24, AT-25, AT-26, AT-27 pass with direct old-write requests, hostile scope/credentials, traversal/symlink/oversized files and malicious labels/source links, while protected bytes remain unchanged.
No generic dispatch, optional service invocation, runtime secret leakage, broad CORS, arbitrary source/asset access or cross-project route/session/cache data exists.
verification_steps: Run targeted HTTP suites with two namespaces and one shared label/different meanings; exercise resource exhaustion, bounded retry and safe failures.
Inspect import/call graph for authoring/provisioning/build/wiki/memory functions; instrument forbidden operations to fail if invoked.

tasks.title: Verify actual production offline user workflows
tasks.action: Build from the exact approved dependency lock and exercise actual production launch, health, all reader destinations, history, sources and graph/list under real CSP and network denial.
acceptance_criteria: AT-01, AT-02, AT-03, AT-04, AT-05, AT-06, AT-07, AT-08, AT-09, AT-10, AT-11, AT-12, AT-13, AT-14, AT-15, AT-16, AT-17, AT-18, AT-19, AT-20, AT-21, AT-22, AT-23, AT-28, AT-29, AT-32, AT-34 each has observed production evidence and exact fixture/build identity.
Installed bundle works without Node server, external assets, embeddings/RDF/inference, profile enablement or Director publication grants; missing assets fail specifically.
verification_steps: Execute documented production build only after explicit dependency/build authorization, then launch explicit reader with target Python runtime; no dev-server evidence substitutes.
Use Playwright or existing equivalent for complete search-entry-source-history-map/list/process flows under denied external network and actual CSP; store safe screenshots/results.

tasks.title: Record keyboard and assistive technology acceptance
tasks.action: Evaluate production interface semantics, contrasts, targets, reflow, focus and essential actions using automated scans plus manual keyboard and screen-reader knowledge tasks.
acceptance_criteria: AT-29, AT-30, labeled search/combobox behavior, visible unobscured focus, contrast and applicable 24px target exceptions have specific evidence.
Actual browser/AT versions include macOS VoiceOver/Safari; Windows combination is tested when available or its non-exercise is explicit.
A scanner pass is never an unqualified WCAG compliance claim and diagram exception never excuses surrounding text/control reflow.
verification_steps: Run automated accessibility checks on all destinations, states and both themes.
Manually follow search, entry, sources, map/list, menus, Escape/focus return, narrow/zoom and reduced-motion tasks; retain exact environments and failures.

tasks.title: Prove end-to-end browsing nonmutation
tasks.action: Compare complete protected-state hashes and relevant timestamps before and after the actual production browser read workflow, including optional services absent and wiki/memory missing or stale.
acceptance_criteria: AT-33 establishes unchanged ontology/source configuration, memory data/config, proposals, publication receipts and generated products across all reads.
Only exact documented startup session/runtime files and harmless preference keys are exempt; no broad .sys4ai exemption exists.
Opening evidence never repairs source hashes and stale/missing wiki never triggers rebuild or blocks definitions.
verification_steps: Hash/stat protected paths before and after safe reads, expansion, source open, malformed requests and expiry.
Inspect runtime artifacts created by explicit launch and classify every change; unexpected mutations fail the gate.

tasks.title: Benchmark bounded representative and pathological workloads
tasks.action: Measure production performance and resource behavior at small, representative and stress fixture shapes with actual hardware/browser/build/limits and cold/warm conditions.
acceptance_criteria: AT-36 reports repeated-run median and p95, memory, enforced limits and graceful degradation at approximate 50/100, 1000/5000 and 5000/50000 entry/relation targets, with loader capacity measured.
Proposed 2s cold first-read, warm search p95 200ms excluding debounce, entry p95 250ms, 1.5s focused 25/50 graph and 100ms loaded selection remain reported targets; actual misses remain visible.
Additional connections leave the old view usable with bounded progress/cancellation; source validation cost and compressed bundle size are measured separately.
verification_steps: Run cold/warm repetitions and high-degree/long-definition/many-source/cycles/cancellation fixtures; document sample counts and timing boundaries.
If profiling shows source validation dominates, test validated immutable reuse before proposing a contract change; never use stale-as-current data to improve timings.

tasks.title: Validate comprehension with people
tasks.action: Conduct small exploratory production knowledge-task walkthroughs with someone unfamiliar with implementation, or document owner-only walkthrough and broader validation as unperformed.
acceptance_criteria: Participant can attempt find/explain term, distinguish terms, interpret relation endpoints/meaning, visit neighbor/return, understand supported or absent process order and inspect freshness.
Record completion, wrong turns, mistaken meanings, requests for help and participant wording; 30s known-term target stays proposed and no statistical generalization is made.
Resolve high-impact reversed-direction or layout-causality misconceptions before claiming usable release; owner-only results state the limitation.
verification_steps: Run the named knowledge tasks without implementation vocabulary coaching; record safe concise observations and elapsed time.
Recheck any high-impact fix through the affected focused browser/semantic/accessibility tests and targeted walkthrough.

tasks.title: Publish reviewed source assets to the registered Template
tasks.action: Complete reusable package contracts/manifest/notices/docs and neutral starter mappings, then use the Template update owner to distribute the exact reviewed release files.
risks: Existing watcher may distribute before a manual step; coordinate current owner and complete source package, preserve its exact receipt/history rather than racing writers.
acceptance_criteria: Source collection owns every reusable addition/removal; neutral Template includes production runtime assets, lock/build identity/notices and validated own identity/purpose/categories.
No hard-coded depot identity, fixtures/runtime/model/session state, history edits, unrelated restructuring or direct mapped-Template source edits occur.
verification_steps: Run .venv/bin/python tools/template_update.py check; inspect exact source/destination/deletion/neutrality list and any customized conflicts before authorized apply.
Run the registered Template contract suite and inspect installed bundle/read package completeness; retain updater receipt and fresh current check.

tasks.title: Prepare exact active-root adoption and rollback manifest
tasks.action: Inspect installed root copies/local instructions and record exact source/destination/hash/overwrite/preservation and rollback boundaries for future root adoption.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest lists exact allowed root files and customizations, current checks and reversible code/assets/configuration backups; latest ontology/memory/history are outside rollback targets.
Adoption proceeds only on separately recorded exact authority; registration/equality/Template delivery alone is not an authorization.
verification_steps: Compare each source and destination and inspect root guidance/schema compatibility; verify proposed write set contains no product-root wildcard.
Review rollback behavior against canonical data/history and current newer input versions before root mutation.

tasks.title: Adopt and verify the production reader in the root
tasks.action: Apply only separately authorized exact root adoption files through their owners and verify root, neutral Template and an explicitly selected second namespace fixture.
risks: If root adoption authority is unavailable, retain an explicit incomplete release gate; do not mark root behavior verified.
acceptance_criteria: Root reader is explicitly launchable while workbench normal-entry cutover remains gated; source/installed/Template files match the reviewed manifest.
AT-31 demonstrates independent IDs/routes/caches/preferences/sources/sessions with shared-label different meanings; no product registration or scanning is added.
verification_steps: Run actual production launch/read/search/process/map/list/source checks for root and installed neutral Template plus second namespace fixture.
Attempt cross-context session/cursor/source reuse and inspect root final diff, protected files and updater state.

tasks.title: Retire active workbench destinations after reader gates
tasks.action: Apply reviewed normal-launch cutover, old-command deprecation and active frontend asset retirement while preserving shared trusted-authority and agent operations; distribute/adopt the final changed set through existing boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Current runtime/docs/launchers/distribution no longer offer authoring browser destinations or import old editor/review/advanced frontend modules.
Every trusted helper caller survives with compatible meaning; shared helpers are preserved or explicitly moved with compatible imports before old service removal.
Old command emits documented reader deprecation and rejects authoring/grant options; old authoring credentials are not migrated.
Historical snapshots/proposals/receipts/memory/canonical content survive; exact retired asset deletion and root adoption have recorded authority.
verification_steps: Repeat active caller inventory and compare against TASK-001; classify historical matches separately.
Run direct old-write endpoint failures plus current launch/health and production reader cutover smoke on final installed assets.
Run fresh updater check/apply/check and root exact adoption verification for final retirement changes only.

tasks.title: Verify preserved agent workflows and recovery
tasks.action: Run source and installed-root retrieval, proposal/validation/review/publication/authority/recovery and Template regression gates independently of browser read-only evidence.
acceptance_criteria: AT-35 compares current source/installed results against actual baseline, preserving agent semantic defaults, retrieval limits, explicit wiki generation and trusted publication/recovery behavior.
Any pre-existing failures, unavailable optional runtimes or skipped environments remain distinct from new regressions and successful checks.
verification_steps: Run baseline targeted query/publication suites and affected proposal/guard/recovery/health suites; run full ontology suite only when affected scope justifies it and required existing profiles are known.
Exercise a real isolated publication/recovery fixture with current helper imports; do not publish into the active root merely to prove CLI preservation.
Run current Template contract and source/installed package comparison checks.

tasks.title: Assess provenance effects and verify reversible migration
tasks.action: Inventory affected recorded hashes, locked inputs and helper certifications after code settles, and execute only separately authorized owner maintenance; exercise code/assets/config rollback without restoring obsolete knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Every affected provenance/certification item has an explicit maintenance disposition and truthful evidence; warnings are never mechanically silenced by browsing.
Frontend acceptance and any authorized source/certification maintenance have separate results.
Rollback preserves newer valid ontology/memory, proposals and publication history and requires no knowledge reconstruction.
verification_steps: Review final changed source/helper hashes against locked references and existing maintenance contracts; capture any pending owner action as a release limit.
Exercise rollback in an isolated installed fixture containing newer canonical/history records and verify exact preservation before/after.

tasks.title: Close requirement and acceptance evidence coverage
tasks.action: Reopen final source/root/Template artifacts and audit every REQ and AT in both directions against actual implementation and current evidence, including preservation and integrated behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All 49 unchanged requirements and AT-01 through AT-36 have artifact and current evidence references; planned/synthetic/static/manual/runtime outcomes remain distinguishable.
Every changed artifact has requirement/design provenance; protected paths, source/root/Template ownership and independent product boundaries are accounted for.
Missing mandatory behavior or unproven required environment is explicit incomplete/blocked rather than silently satisfied; unqualified completion is impossible with unresolved mandatory gaps.
verification_steps: Reopen exact build/canonical/source/installed artifacts and compare requirement acceptance sentences verbatim against TRD revision 2.
Verify matrix has no orphan implementation, untested obligation or changed artifact outside the final approved manifest; record final preservation after current implementation evidence.

tasks.title: Deliver production visuals and operational handoff
tasks.action: Publish the local release evidence report and safe production visuals with exact launch/build/config/compatibility/maintenance/rollback instructions and all tested limits.
acceptance_criteria: Actual production visuals cover Overview, search, populated entry, process, focused map, parallel edges, source drawer, incomplete results and narrow screen.
Report names actual commit/build, changed map, commands/tests, browsers/AT, timings/limits, nonmutation, root/Template evidence, content gaps, skips/failures and untested environments.
Screenshots/evidence contain no bootstrap/session material or unnecessary private sources; no Git publication, external sharing or deployment occurs absent separate authority.
verification_steps: Open each final screenshot and follow evidence/document links; compare commands to current help output and installed bundle manifest.
Confirm plan/Task completion claims use the highest observed verification level and identify unperformed user/environment validation rather than presenting plans as results.
